description:
Start an AI-visibility scan of a company's website. It asks ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode real buying queries and records which companies they name. A free scan asks 5 queries on each engine, 25 in all. A call carrying a TofuBofu API key (Authorization: Bearer tb_live_...) re-scans that workspace's existing brand for the website, on its plan and quota.

Before calling: call research_company, walk the user through its steps, show them the pre-filled answers and the queries (for a returning brand, the ones its last scan asked, which this scan asks again), and get a yes. Ask where they sell if you do not know it: geo_scope changes every query. Omit a field you do not know rather than inventing a value.

The scan runs in the background (a few minutes); call get_visibility_report with the returned report_id. Returns report_id, report_url, assumed (answers not supplied) and query_warnings (buyer_questions that read as a topic, each with its reason; every one is still asked as sent). status "not_started" with report_id null means no scan ran: the email already has an account, or this website's free scan already ran this month. A sign-in link went to that inbox; show the note and stop.

brand_name.description: Is this you? The company name as buyers say it, read from the website and confirmed or corrected by the user. Omit it if the user did not say.
brand_name.title: Brand Name

buyer_audience.description: Who buys from you? Whether this brand's buyers are businesses or people, as the user said. One of: business (Businesses); consumer (Consumers). Omit it if the user did not say.
buyer_audience.title: Buyer Audience

buyer_questions.description: Queries your buyers ask. Queries this company's buyers ask. Each is put to the engines as written, every scan. Omit it if the user did not say.
buyer_questions.title: Buyer Questions

capacity.description: Who will do the fixes? Who on the user's side will make the changes. One of: solo; one_marketer (One marketer); small_team (A small team, 2 to 4); full_team (A full team, 5 or more). Omit it if the user did not say.
capacity.title: Capacity

competitors.description: Who else would a buyer consider? Companies the user says a buyer would pick instead of them. We track whoever the engines name either way, so this is the user's own view rather than the whole comparison set. Omit it if the user did not say.
competitors.title: Competitors

confirmed.description: The params above that the user confirmed or answered, as opposed to values you passed through from research_company unchallenged. A value not listed here is recorded as our guess, not as their answer.
confirmed.title: Confirmed

differentiator.description: What makes you different? One line. Leave it blank if nothing stands out. Omit it if the user did not say.
differentiator.title: Differentiator

domain.description: The company's website or domain, e.g. "acme.com".
domain.title: Domain

email.description: The user's work email. Required: we send the finished report there and it identifies the account. One free scan per website a month.
email.title: Email

geo_scope.description: Where do you sell? Where the brand's buyers are. One of: global (Anywhere); national (Across one country); national_local (National, with a local angle); local (My own city or region). Omit it if the user did not say.
geo_scope.title: Geo Scope

hired_by.description: Who usually hires you? Who signs the contract, in their words. Up to three. Omit it if the user did not say.
hired_by.title: Hired By

locations.description: Which places? The country you sell across, or the cities you are bound to. Omit it if the user did not say.
locations.title: Locations

not_for.description: Who are you NOT for? The buyer you turn away, and why. Saying it costs nothing and it is what makes the rest of the answer specific. Omit it if the user did not say.
not_for.title: Not For

platform.description: What is your site built on? Decides which publishing route we can offer you. One of: wordpress (WordPress); webflow (Webflow); hubspot (HubSpot); shopify (Shopify); squarespace (Squarespace); wix (Wix); framer (Framer); custom (Something custom). Omit it if the user did not say.
platform.title: Platform

product_category.description: What would a buyer search for to find you? What a buyer would type to find a company like yours, in their words. Omit it if the user did not say.
product_category.title: Product Category

segment_buyer_roles.description: Who reads the shortlist? The roles who compare vendors and hand up a recommendation. Omit it if the user did not say.
segment_buyer_roles.title: Segment Buyer Roles

segment_industries.description: Which industries do you sell into? The verticals your buyers work in. Leave it empty if you sell across all of them. Omit it if the user did not say.
segment_industries.title: Segment Industries

sells_to.description: What size and type of customer? SMB and enterprise are different queries with different winners. Omit it if the user did not say.
sells_to.title: Sells To

services.description: Which services do you want to be recommended for? Up to three services this brand wants AI engines to recommend it for, in a buyer's words. Omit it if the user did not say.
services.title: Services

tg_occasions.description: When do they buy it? The occasion or moment this brand is bought for. Consumer brands only. Omit it if the user did not say.
tg_occasions.title: Tg Occasions

tg_people.description: Which people? The consumer group this brand sells to, e.g. parents or students. Consumer brands only. Omit it if the user did not say.
tg_people.title: Tg People

name: scan_ai_visibility
